meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后，这个技能会把 NanoClaw 智能体组的请求改发到本地的 Ollama 模型（如 qwen3-coder），不再走 Anthropic 的云端 API。它会自动调整容器环境变量、屏蔽 Anthropic 域名，并设定模型名称，让智能体用本地开源模型回复。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在本地运行、节省 API 开销，或试用开放权重模型时，说出切换意图即可触发。技能会先询问你选用哪个 agent 组和哪个 Ollama 模型，然后执行配置。

say.text: 把 my-agent 组切换到本地 Ollama 模型 qwen3-coder
say.note: 配置后该组的消息会发给本地 Ollama。

say.text: 帮我屏蔽 Anthropic API，让这个 agent 组完全走本地模型
改用 Ollama 的 gemma4 模型，并重启服务
say.note: 构建并重启后，可验证模型是否激活。

howto.what_en: This skill routes a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model (e.g. qwen3-coder) instead of the Anthropic API. It adjusts container environment variables, blocks the Anthropic domain, and sets the model name so the agent replies with a local open-weights model.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user wants to run agents locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weights models. The skill will ask which agent group and which Ollama model to use, then applies the configuration.

say_en.text: Switch my-agent group to local Ollama model qwen3-coder
say_en.note: After setup, messages go to local Ollama.

say_en.text: Block the Anthropic API and make this agent group fully local
say_en.note: Resolves api.anthropic.com to 0.0.0.0 in the container.

say_en.text: Use Ollama model gemma4 and restart the service
say_en.note: After rebuild and restart, you can verify the model is active.
